name: Капитан стражи шахт
notes: A captain of the deep mines guard of Kragmir, a generic type (one or two per map). The captain runs a street squad of Стражник шахт and fights the way they do: to arrest, with the sap, manacles, and orders, until the party kills a guard; after that the war axe comes out. The mines guard is a separate force from the army detachment at the fort, and Kragmir's guard has no mages. Table note: Aura of Command buffs only lower-level guards that carry Effect: Under Command; every Стражник шахт actor already carries it.

actions.name: Aura of Command
actions.text:
30 feet. The captain bolsters lower-level guards under their command, granting them a +1 status bonus to their attack rolls and a +2 status bonus to their Will saves.

actions.name: Air of Authority
actions.text: 10 feet. Creatures in the aura who are the same or lower level than the captain take a -2 status penalty to their Will DC against the captain's attempts to [[/act coerce]] or [[/act demoralize]] them.

actions.name: Stop in the Name of the Law!
actions.text: The captain Strides twice and then [[/act demoralize]]{Demoralizes}. On a success, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed] with a value equal to its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened] value until it is no longer frightened.

actions.name: Shielded Advance
actions.text:
Requirements The captain has their shield raised

Effect The captain presses forward, using their shield to push back foes. The captain Strides and [[/act shove]]{Shoves}, in either order. The multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Shove, though the Shove does count toward the captain's multiple attack penalty.

actions.name: Dwarven Doughtiness
actions.text: Dwarves are often calm and collected in the face of imminent danger. At the end of the captain's turn, reduce its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened] condition by 2 instead of 1.
